feeds.title: Bar Magazine
feeds.description: Dating back to 1999, Bar Magazine is the leading monthly publication that represents the hospitality sector. Each issue is packed with invaluable guidance and business help for venue owners, operators and managers. The exclusive monthly content covers all aspects of creating and running a successful bar, pub or restaurant. From planning, design and installation through to training, law, finance and technology.

feeds.title: Steve the Barman Blog
feeds.description: Enjoy blogs and videos providing value, knowledge, reviews, and an insight into Steve the Barman's world for providing Cocktail & Gin nights in and around Cambridge & Essex. Steve has been a Cocktail Bartender for over 25 years, excelling in Customer Service, Friendliness, and Amazing Drinks.

feeds.title: The Cocktail Lovers Magazine
feeds.description: The Cocktail Lovers are on a mission to find the best cocktails and cocktail bars in London. From classic cocktails to modern mixology, Cocktail Lovers visit the bars, talk to the bartenders, and drink and mix the cocktails that make London home to the best cocktails and cocktail bars in the world.

feeds.title: Tom Dyer Bartender Blog
feeds.description: If you hadn't already guessed I am a bartender and I do bartendy things. I create great cocktails and I can teach your team how to get them right every time. I am also a multi-award-winning world-champion flair bartender. You can find me on 'YouTube' mixing up tasty beverages and teaching flair bartending. Find out what's new in the flair bartending world and get all the news and reviews on bar tools.

feeds.title: Cocktails With Mario Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the home of Cocktails with Mario.If you are planning a party for yourself or a friend, organizing a corporate event, or simply want to learn the tricks of the trade with a few friends, then hire a barman to ensure that our cutting-edge mixed drink bars are ideal for any occasion you have in mind. Our cocktail barman has the perfect solution to make your party interesting.

feeds.title: Cocktail Hire Blog
feeds.description: In-depth details on running and hosting events from hiring a cocktail bartender through to completion - with images and videos!

feeds.title: Spin And Shake Blog
feeds.description: Spin and Shake Mobile Bar Hire London is an award-winning mobile cocktail bar company. We provide over 500 events every year while making sure every single one go smoothly. Read our cocktail blog for info and curiosity about the awesome world of cocktails and bartending. Learn recipes and history about cocktails.

feeds.title: The Bartender Hire Co. Blog
feeds.description: From mobile bar hire, staffing for events, and cocktail experiences, to complete event management, we provide everything you could possibly need to make your event a great one. We focus on offering great cocktails with a service second to none. Read cocktail information, recipes, and drinks-making tips and tricks for the budding home bartender amongst you.

feeds.title: Bar Life UK
feeds.description: BarLifeUK launched in 2010, and quickly became one of the leading information resources for the bar trade, both at home in the UK, and overseas. Follow this site to know about everything related to bar and bar trade.
